import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for survived
survival_palette = {0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}
survival_labels = {0: 'Did Not Survive', 1: 'Survived'}

# Plot 1: Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#3498db', '#e91e63'], edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for container in ax1.containers:
    ax1.bar_label(container, fmt='%.2f', fontsize=8)

# Plot 2: Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for survived_val in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['survived'] == survived_val]['age'].dropna()
    ax2.hist(subset, bins=30, alpha=0.6, label=survival_labels[survived_val], 
             color=survival_palette[survived_val], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()

# Plot 3: Fare distribution by class (box plot)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
class_order = ['First', 'Second', 'Third']
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='class', y='fare', hue='survived', ax=ax3, 
            palette=survival_palette, order=class_order)
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare ($)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 300)  # Limit y-axis to better visualize most data
handles, labels = ax3.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax3.legend(handles, [survival_labels[int(l)] for l in labels], title='Survival Status')

# Plot 4: Survival count by embarkation port
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival = embark_survival.reindex(['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Queenstown'])
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=[survival_palette[0], survival_palette[1]], 
                     edgecolor='black', stacked=True)
ax4.set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Port and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.legend(title='Survival Status', labels=[survival_labels[0], survival_labels[1]])

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
